name: Ilse
public: A young woman in a clerk's grey with the harbour ledger under her arm; neat, exact, watchful.
card:
Name: Ilse Calloway
Age: 24
Role: Clerk of the harbour ledger; Wren's older sister.

Personality: Careful, exact, and more afraid of being wrong than of being in danger. Believes the ledger until it contradicts itself, then believes nothing until she has checked it twice. Calls her sister by name when she is worried.

Voice: Precise and procedural; states the facts before the conclusion. Never guesses aloud: she says 'the ledger says' or 'I don't know yet'.

Wants: to keep her post, and to keep Wren safe; tonight those may not be the same thing.
